title: No evidence of neural feature-specific pre-activation during the prediction of an upcoming stimulus
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Classify the four actually presented tones from individual-participant MEG at the original train/test time samples: train on random sequences and test all four entropy conditions under source Pipeline 1. Preserve the full temporal-generalization accuracy panel and sound/omission analyses separately; inferential pre-activation claims are distinct from decoder-performance gains.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Classify the four actually presented tones from individual-participant MEG at the original train/test time samples: train on random sequences and test all four entropy conditions under source Pipeline 1. Preserve the full temporal-generalization accuracy panel and sound/omission analyses separately; inferential pre-activation claims are distinct from decoder-performance gains.

Source-paper comparison for Original Pipeline 1 percentage of correctly decoded tones across the full source participant/time/entropy panel: Tone accuracy is correct predictions divided by tested trials at each train/test time. Scientific assessment compares original and null maps and entropy correlations; 0.25 alone is not a valid prestimulus null.
success_criteria: Recover exact original Pipeline1 published decoder accuracy matrices, full participant/trial/fold support, source timing and all four entropy conditions, including the original sound/omission distinctions.
Reproduce the publication-aligned participant-specific LDA baseline and resolve stratified-fold, filtering and time-window discrepancies before candidate comparison.
Freeze candidate, original inputs and preprocessing, meaningful effect, full-panel aggregation/multiplicity, participant-level uncertainty and matched budgets before final evaluation.

Surpass the source decoder on identical original support under that declared rule. New splits, easier input conditions, a favorable time/entropy subset or a corrected_methods_v1 profile are extensions, not historical same-task victories.

Retain empirical reordered-sequence and theoretical confusion/transition controls. Higher prestimulus accuracy alone does not establish anticipatory neural information, and stronger evidence for the paper's null conclusion is not decoder improvement.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
